purpose: Reduce mounted-Drive operation count with one dev-only input capsule, local evaluation/logging and occasional archived result checkpoints
input_capsule: Frozen benchmark manifest plus unchanged adapter bundle plus only the 20 dev shards; full source dataset and held-out image/GT bodies excluded
input_reads: First creation reads the 22 source files once. Subsequent fresh sessions copy one capsule. A complete local capsule is reused without Drive file-data or metadata probes.
checkpoint_policy: One portable progress ZIP after each four verified dev shards, plus a complete archive at the end. Only the verified prefix is snapshotted even if the child process runs ahead. Fresh-VM recovery reuses the last successful archived checkpoint, not necessarily every locally completed image.
drive_write_failure_policy: Keep evaluating locally after an OSError saving progress; disable further Drive writes for that invocation and tell the user to download local results and complete progress
offline_mode: USE_DRIVE=False with a previously prepared capsule uploaded through Colab Files; local outputs must be downloaded before VM deletion
active_quota_policy: Does not reset/bypass quotas. No automatic remount or retry loop; the first capsule requires readable source files. Wait for service quota recovery when Colab reports quota exhaustion.
safety_checks: frozen data/model identities and nested file hashes
safe archive paths and exact dev-only inventory
250 MB transfer/archive bound prevents copying full dataset
wrapper termination stops its evaluator child
